definitions.gloss: play; drama; dramatic work (as a piece of literature)
definitions.explanation: A play considered as a written literary work, meant to be performed on stage. Used of works by playwrights such as Shakespeare or Chekhov.

examples.japanese: シェークスピア⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{戯曲|ぎきょく}。
{戯曲|ぎきょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。

⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{後|のち}→後：03545_nochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{戯曲|ぎきょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}き{直|なお}され→書き直す：04597_kakinaosu⟧、⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{上演|じょうえん}→上演：11297_jouen⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The novel was later rewritten as a play and staged.

notes:
The literary text of a play. ⟦{脚本|きゃくほん}→脚本：04459_kyakuhon⟧ and ⟦{台本|だいほん}→台本：11868_daihon⟧ are working scripts for actors and staff (films, TV, and plays alike), while {戯曲|ぎきょく} is the play as literature, read and studied as well as performed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戯曲|ぎきょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write a play
- {戯曲|ぎきょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上演|じょうえん}→上演：11297_jouen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to stage a play
- {戯曲|ぎきょく}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to adapt into a play
- {戯曲集|ぎきょくしゅう}: a collection of plays
